name: Tapo P100 (UK)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only (802.11b/g/n). Bluetooth 4.2 is used only for setup.

matter.note: No official source states Matter support or rules it out for the P100; the UK pages don't list it. TP-Link's Matter version is the separate Tapo P100M.

apple_home.note: TP-Link's UK P100 pages list only Alexa and Google Assistant and don't mention Apple Home, but no official page says it is unsupported. The Tapo P100M is the Matter version.

google_home.note: Through the Tapo cloud link (Works with Google Home). Set the plug up in the Tapo app first.

alexa.note: Through the Tapo Alexa skill, linked to your TP-Link account.

smartthings.note: TP-Link's SmartThings FAQ covers Tapo plugs in general without naming models, and the UK P100 pages list only Alexa and Google Assistant. The EU P100 page lists SmartThings, but that is a different model. Not confirmed for the UK version.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's TP-Link Smart Home integration lists the P100 among supported Tapo plugs. Newer devices need your TP-Link account credentials once.

hubRequired.note: The Tapo UK page says no hub is required; it joins your 2.4 GHz router directly.

localControl.note: Home Assistant's TP-Link integration controls it over the local network, though newer firmware needs TP-Link account credentials to authenticate. We found no TP-Link page on Tapo-app control without internet.

energyMonitoring.note: TP-Link's plug FAQ says the P110 and P115 measure energy and the P100 does not; the UK P100 pages list no energy monitoring.

maxLoadWatts.note: 13 A / 2990 W, 1/6 HP motor, 220-240 V. The EU version is 10 A / 2300 W.

summary: Tapo's UK P100 gives plain on/off control from Alexa and Google Home, linked through your TP-Link account in the Tapo app. Home Assistant's TP-Link integration also supports it on the local network; SmartThings isn't confirmed for this UK model. It takes 13 A (2990 W) on 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi with no hub and no energy monitoring. TP-Link doesn't list Apple Home or Matter for it; the separate Tapo P100M is the Matter version.
caveats: TP-Link doesn't list Apple Home or Matter; the Tapo P100M is the Matter version.
No energy monitoring; TP-Link says the P110 and P115 are the Tapo plugs that measure power.
Ratings differ by region: this UK version is 13 A / 2990 W, the EU version 10 A / 2300 W.
Home Assistant's TP-Link integration asks for your TP-Link account credentials once on newer firmware.
Motor loads are limited to 1/6 HP.
